topics.text: The hotel is in a great location with beautiful views, quiet surroundings, and some are in the mountains. There are nice outdoor areas like hot baths and pools.
Rooms are beautiful and complete with good facilities. Some have pools, and there are common areas for relaxation
Staff are friendly, accommodating, and helpful, providing various assistance like arranging drivers and introducing local places
Guests can use the kitchen, and the hotel is suitable for family and pet stays, offering a unique experience with beautiful scenery

suggestion.text: Some customers suggest room vs promo, bathroom issues, musty smell, pricey breakfast not meeting expectations

address: No. 32, Yangwukeng, Xiantan Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, 313000, China

comments.quote: A hidden gem of a B&B in Xiantan Village, it looks just like something out of a Miyazaki fairy tale – so unique! We got upgraded to a dome room during the off-season, and I loved the tatami relaxation area...
comments.author: Xixiniaoxi

comments.quote: Very friendly staff, great location, beautiful room and a very nice view!
